extraction_gaps.reason: Only the insufficient-balance rejection copy exists in the frames; the RFC lists three further error codes with no designed copy.
extraction_gaps.action: ask design for the NOT_FIRST_TIME / NOT_GOPAY / EXPIRED rejection copy

visual_analysis_scratchpad: Design covers two navigational screens for the SAVE20 promo feature: the GoFood restaurant menu (with its 'Checkout' entry point) and the GoFood cart-review/checkout screen, which holds the promo-code field, apply button, an error label, and the cart total. Promo validation, loading, success and rejection are all visual states of the single cart-review screen rather than separate screens.

blocking_issues: Rejection copy is only designed for the insufficient-balance case; NOT_FIRST_TIME, NOT_GOPAY, and EXPIRED rejections (per the RFC's error codes) have no corresponding mockup or copy.
The discount amount has no independently exposed UI element — only the combined cart_total text changes when SAVE20 is applied, so the discount value itself isn't separately verifiable on-screen.
The SAVE20 discount value itself (20% vs a flat Rp20,000) is not shown as a concrete figure anywhere in the design — matches prd_context's open question.

elements.label: Checkout

interactions.action: Navigates to GOFOOD_CART_REVIEW with the current cart contents.

validations_and_edge_cases: Must remain disabled while the cart is empty.

element_ambiguity.reason: The disabled-state copy/behavior for an empty cart is not shown in the source frames.

screens.screen_notes: Deep link: gojek://food/menu/{restaurant_id} (not part of this EPIC's change scope).

elements.label: Masukkan kode promo

interactions.action: Focuses field and opens standard keyboard.
Submits the entered code for validation via the apply button.

validations_and_edge_cases: No character-count or format constraint is shown for the code itself.

elements.label: Terapkan

interactions.action: Validates the code via the promo API; on success shows Promo Applied state, on failure shows Promo Rejected state with GOFOOD_CART_REVIEW.promo_error_label populated.

validations_and_edge_cases: Remains disabled until the promo code field has a value.
Repeated taps while loading must not double-apply the promo (see change_context CR-07).

element_ambiguity.reason: State transitions are clearly implied by the loading/applied/rejected screen states.

elements.label: Promo error message
validations_and_edge_cases: Only the insufficient-balance message is designed; other rejection reasons have no copy.

element_ambiguity.reason: No copy/mockup exists for the not-first-time, non-GoPay, or expired-code rejection reasons defined in the RFC's error codes, so this element's full behavior can't be verified from the design alone.

elements.label: Total belanja
validations_and_edge_cases: Must reflect the discounted amount immediately once a promo is successfully applied.

element_ambiguity.reason: The discount is only visible as a change in this combined total text — there is no separate, independently assertable discount element in the design.

screens.screen_notes: Deep link: gojek://food/cart/review (see plan_context hook HOOK-DL-CART — the primary automation path into this screen; the GOFOOD_MENU → GOFOOD_CART_REVIEW ui_flow below is the UI-walk fallback).
